description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S + vision tuned for ~5 concurrent 256k contexts per worker (ctx=1310720, slots=5) using KV cache q8_0. Best on 96GB GPUs (BLACKWELL_96).
readme_intro: Configured for 5 concurrent ~256k contexts on a single large-VRAM GPU by using a shared total context: ctx=1,310,720 and slots=5 yields ~262,144 tokens per slot. Keep MAX_CONCURRENCY equal to slots. If you see OOM during prompt ingestion, reduce UBATCH. If you see OOM during long generation, reduce slots or switch KV cache to q4_0.

description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S + vision tuned for ~5 concurrent 512k contexts per worker (ctx=2621440, slots=5) with KV cache q4_0.
readme_intro: Aggressive long-context config. Uses KV cache q4_0 to reduce VRAM. If unstable or OOM, reduce slots (N_PARALLEL) or reduce Context Size. Keep MAX_CONCURRENCY equal to N_PARALLEL.

description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ3_S + vision tuned for a single ~1M context request per worker (ctx=1048576, slots=1) using KV cache q8_0.
readme_intro: Single-slot ultra-long-context config. If you want faster prompt ingestion and have headroom, try UBATCH=2048; if you see OOM during prefill, lower UBATCH. For throughput, scale workers rather than raising MAX_CONCURRENCY above 1.

description: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next Coder GGUF tuned for A40-class and other 45GB+ GPUs. Balanced long context without requiring 96GB cards.
readme_intro: Coder variant intended for 48GB-class GPUs (A40 / RTX A6000 / L40S / 6000 Ada). Default is 256k context, single slot. Raise slots only if you have VRAM headroom; keep MAX_CONCURRENCY equal to slots.
